primary_object_card.object_statement: A finite predictive object is the state-relabeling-invariant exact distribution of binary words through length eight generated by one minimal strongly connected four-state rational unifilar process; learned embeddings may predict this equivalence from lossy trajectories but cannot define or certify it.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: Two hidden machines count as the same bounded object only when they make exactly the same predictions for every binary word through length eight. The neural model sees only separately sampled damaged output streams and may learn to group or predict those objects, but exact rational semantics remain external.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Freezes the finite process family, prospective splits, lossy views, learner, controls, metrics, and claim ceiling.
Freezes canonical machines and hard-negative declarations before learner source or test scores exist.

native_terms.predictive object: An equivalence class whose members have identical exact rational probabilities for every binary word of lengths one through eight under the frozen uniform-start convention.
native_terms.lossy view: Independent masked and substituted trajectories with no state or object identifiers.
native_terms.semantic owner: Julia exact rational reconstruction and equivalence checks, never the learned embedding.

weirdness_signature: identity is a finite predictive equivalence class rather than a hidden machine label
independent corrupted streams may present one object without a state correspondence
a learned cluster can predict but cannot define exact objecthood
primary_object_card.domain: minimal strongly connected four-state binary rational unifilar processes and independently corrupted trajectories
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: exact predictive signatures, learned view embeddings, unseen-object clusters, held-out predictions, and bounded control receipts
allowed_operations: canonicalize finite machines under state permutations
fit a fixed sequence model on training objects
cluster and predict sealed unseen objects
run frozen optimizer, label, temporal, marginal, and architecture controls
required_invariants: test objects are selected before learner source exists
model tensors contain no state, object, hash, split, or PRNG identity
views share no latent trajectories or corruption draws
exact semantics never read a learned result
all seeds, arms, objects, and controls are retained
forbidden_substitutions: learned cluster as exact latent-machine recovery
learned proxy or machine label replacing the exact predictive-signature definition
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: Julia, JAX, and PyTorch are typed evidence roles. Julia defines finite predictive equivalence; JAX independently reconstructs and batches; PyTorch predicts only from lossy streams.
promotion_locks: no learned-perception wording unless every seed and control gate passes
no exact recovery wording from finite-horizon prediction
no QIT, FEP, MMM, ontology, or real-world promotion from this classical finite family
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: versioned preregistration, exact object manifest, three independent engine receipts, controller validation, and fabrication audit
blocked_downstream_consumers: Axis0, FEP, physics, life, or consciousness

root_constraints: finite process, trajectory, and prediction sets
extended_constraints: Julia Canon, JAX workhorse, and PyTorch learner

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair provenance, leakage, or object-preservation failures before model tuning
loop_contract.stop_condition: all frozen gates pass or the learned unseen-object claim is decisively red

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question asks for an answer; it is not authorization to implement unless the user explicitly says to do it.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Any sequence or ordering claim must be checked separately from content correctness, with the order witness named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: When debugging runtime behavior, preserve the tuned visible/output baseline and debug the execution path underneath.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: A Popper pass names the target claim, strongest live falsifier, decisive check, and killed/open/survived classification before agreement.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: A Feynman pass names the operation, the observable measured, and the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must name distinct receipts and explicitly refuse the merge, sequence, or reframe it is not performing.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve with tools before asking; ask the human only for private, preference-bound, or unrecoverable information.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 object-preservation preflight before three-engine execution.

source_math_locks.preserves: finite object family, splits, views, learner, controls, and claim ceiling

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: bounded learned recovery on one prospective finite process family only
